summary: Use synthetic host examples in fractal-web sidebar search hints and tests so the public fixture privacy gate passes without weakening its rules.

replay.detail: No claims or replay behavior change.

schema.detail: No database, index, trigger, or schema-version changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention, authority, admission, or rules-version changes.

compatibility.detail: Only accessible search examples and test data change; host-filter semantics and protocols are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No startup work or interruption is required.

manual.detail: No operator actions or configuration changes are required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes; rollback restores the previous search examples and tests.
